workflow_runs.display_title: fix: handle all web_search actions and in progress invocations (#9960)

head_commit.message: fix: handle all web_search actions and in progress invocations (#9960) ### Summary - Parse all `web_search` tool actions (`search`, `find_in_page`, `open_page`). - Previously we only parsed + displayed `search`, which made the TUI appear to pause when the other actions were being used. - Show in progress `web_search` calls as `Searching the web` - Previously we only showed completed tool calls ### Tests Added + updated tests, tested locally ### Follow ups Update VSCode extension to display these as well
